pages.title: Clowders
pages.text: A team is a **Clowder**. Clowders share a pad, share quests, and share Loom Tension: when one of you seats a Strand, all of you hear it.

pages.title: Hall and Charter
pages.text:
**Goal:** claim a pad and reach the Hall.\
You need the **Island Charter** and a **Hub Key** (starter kit / Hall).\
1\. **K** or the **Island Charter** opens the island/team panel. Join or create a team, then pick a pad.\
2\. Right-click a friend with the Charter to invite, or `/clowder invite` / `/clowder accept`.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text:
3\. Sneak-use the Charter on solid pad ground to seal spawn.\
4\. **Hub Key** or `/clowder hub` reaches Clowder Hall. `/clowder return` sends you home. Right-click a Hall Elder to trade Thread.\
**Check:** you are on the intended pad, and `/clowder hub` works.

pages.title: Specialise
pages.text:
A Clowder does not have to climb everything in lockstep. Mid-campaign the braid opens three ways — Pattern, Colony, Hum — and any two carry the whole team into Bind.\
One of you can farm. One can drum. Nobody has to be everyone.
